name: cut-video
domain: rough cut / silence and filler removal
why: The best-documented rough-cut method for talking heads: forced alignment (Montreal Forced Aligner, ~10-20 ms) instead of raw Whisper timestamps, every keep boundary ground-truthed by isolated-window re-transcription, trim+concat instead of select so audio never drifts, and a re-transcription QA pass on the output. The judgement in its SKILL.md is valuable even where the toolchain is not installed.
caveats: Needs Whisper (transcript text) and MFA (conda-installed, auto-downloads models); both are blocked in this sandbox, so run it where those are available or use ffmpeg-skill's silence.py for a coarser cut.
Assumes macOS hardware decode (-hwaccel videotoolbox) and English tiny.en defaults.
